seo.title: ISO Certification Audit Readiness Self-Check | Audit Advisor
seo.description: Assess your management system against one of seven ISO standards. Review documents and working practices, use US and England examples, and get a preparation plan.

assessment.noDataHeading: Resolve the remaining checks before calculating readiness
assessment.noDataDescription: Review any “Not sure” answers and update them after checking the evidence. An overall score is also unavailable if every criterion in a stage has been excluded. Your preparation plan remains available below.
assessment.closingHigh: Save your results, check the remaining items and repeat the assessment after completing the actions.
assessment.closingOther: You now have a starting point and a practical task list. Save the plan and use it to improve your management system step by step.
assessment.method: Available / Yes = 1, Not available / No = 0, and Partly = 0.5 for working-practice questions. Incomplete, outdated or unapproved required documents count as Not available. Permitted Not applicable and No events answers are excluded from the score and do not count as meeting a requirement. Not sure is a follow-up answer: it is included in the plan, and the affected stage and overall score are not calculated until it is resolved. Stage score = 100 × weighted points earned / applicable question weights. Stage shares: {shares}. The overall score combines the stage scores using those shares and is rounded at the end. Question weights: {weights}. If a stage has no applicable criteria, no overall score is calculated. All negative, partial and uncertain answers appear in the plan. Questions have equal numerical weight. Important items are editorial priorities, not an official classification of nonconformities. This is Audit Advisor’s preparation method, not an official conformity scoring system.

levels.title: Early preparation stage
levels.text: Your answers indicate that some management-system elements are in place. Start with the gaps that matter most to your activities.

levels.title: Substantial preparation remains
levels.text: Some elements are working. Address the identified gaps systematically and connect them into an effective management system.

levels.title: The main foundations are in place
levels.text: You have a management-system foundation, with important work still to complete. Finish the actions and verify their effectiveness before the certification audit.

levels.title: High indicative readiness
levels.text: You reported that most of the criteria are met. Focus on the remaining gaps and check that key processes work consistently.

levels.title: Very high indicative readiness
levels.text: Most criteria received positive answers. Next, verify the objective evidence and complete the arrangements for an external audit.
